title: integration test missing_middle_part_is_truncated does not assert decoded data content
description: tests/integration.rs:116: The test asserts only !result.data.is_empty() rather than validating the actual decoded bytes of the present parts. The unit test in reassemble.rs:243-255 does assert the exact bytes (b'Hello, World! ti-part test.') against an oracle. The integration test should assert the exact decoded content (PART1-decoded ++ PART3-decoded) to catch any future regression in partial-reassembly byte ordering. The current assertion is a weak smoke test, not a correctness proof.
